budget_lines_one_match_check.name: budget_lines_one_match_check
budget_lines_one_match_check.value:
(
        (CASE WHEN expense_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN revenue_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN category_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN label IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      ) = 1

budget_lines_side_match_check.name: budget_lines_side_match_check
budget_lines_side_match_check.value: (side = 'in' AND expense_item_id IS NULL) OR (side = 'out' AND revenue_item_id IS NULL)

budgets_scope_project_check.name: budgets_scope_project_check
budgets_scope_project_check.value: (scope = 'project' AND project_id IS NOT NULL) OR (scope = 'period' AND project_id IS NULL)

cost_components_value_check.name: cost_components_value_check
cost_components_value_check.value:
(calc_type = 'fixed_per_unit' AND value_cents IS NOT NULL AND value_rate IS NULL)
          OR (calc_type IN ('percent_of_price', 'percent_of_subtotal') AND value_rate IS NOT NULL AND value_cents IS NULL)

transaction_lines_one_item_check.name: transaction_lines_one_item_check
transaction_lines_one_item_check.value: NOT (revenue_item_id IS NOT NULL AND expense_item_id IS NOT NULL)

transaction_lines_label_check.name: transaction_lines_label_check
transaction_lines_label_check.value: revenue_item_id IS NOT NULL OR expense_item_id IS NOT NULL OR refunded_line_id IS NOT NULL OR label IS NOT NULL

transaction_lines_direction_item_check.name: transaction_lines_direction_item_check
transaction_lines_direction_item_check.value: (direction = 'in' AND expense_item_id IS NULL) OR (direction = 'out' AND revenue_item_id IS NULL)

transaction_lines_revenue_target_check.name: transaction_lines_revenue_target_check
transaction_lines_revenue_target_check.value: direction = 'out' OR target_type IS NULL OR target_type = 'project'

payment_applications_not_self_check.name: payment_applications_not_self_check
payment_applications_not_self_check.value: applied_from_transaction_id IS NULL OR applied_from_transaction_id <> transaction_id

recurring_schedules_direction_check.name: recurring_schedules_direction_check
recurring_schedules_direction_check.value:
(direction = 'in' AND revenue_item_id IS NOT NULL AND expense_item_id IS NULL)
          OR (direction = 'out' AND expense_item_id IS NOT NULL AND revenue_item_id IS NULL)
